text.p: The Navigation Bar is by default docked to the left, and shows a list of available views.

The list is normally ordered based on how much time is spent with each view open, thus keeping the most used views easily accessible. Note the All Views option, that gives an overview of all views and features in $PNAME.
To configure what is displayed on the Navigation Bar, see the Navigation Bar Settings (found under File -> Settings -> Navigation Bar Settings).
